rows.message: ShopBot.showOrder builds a button sending "order:track", which no handler of callback data matches; the handlers match "order:confirm", "order:tracking", /^order:cancel:(\w+)$/, /^order:details:/
rows.evidence: every handler of callback data in the project was read, and none takes every callback

config-not-set.why: the configuration module in src/app.module.ts validates the settings with a schema, which may give it a default

status-never-answered.why: POST /orders/:param/refund throws HttpException, whose status is not read
